scripts.build:android: npm run build:web && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios-sim: npm run build:web && cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/App/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
